title: Carved marks scar the crossroads post — thieves' cant
description: Somebody left instructions here for those who can read them. A shadow shifts at the treeline, watching to see what you do.

onPass.narration: The shadow steps out grinning, clasps arms with your bounty hunter, and presses a share of last week's take into their hands. "For keeping the cant alive."

onFail.narration: Nobody in your company knows the signs. You fumble a guess — and pay for the insult when a sling stone takes your coin pouch clean off its cord.

onPass.narration: Five throws, five hits. The watcher whistles low and tosses you the stake purse before vanishing into the trees.

onFail.narration: Your third throw goes wide. The stake purse — with your coin in it — disappears into the canopy with a laugh.

onPass.narration: You leave the post and its marks behind. The shadow loses interest.
